_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Structural Coupling Test Report
summary: Provides data for the detailed evaluation of the sensitivity of the air vehicle's automatic flight control system to structural response, used to validate or update analytical models.
use_relationship:
The Structural Coupling Test Report provides the data for the detailed evaluation of the sensitivity of the air vehicle's automatic flight control system to structural response and follow-on aeroservoelastic analyses.  The principal use is to validate or update analytical models.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to any contract for which an automated flight control system is being developed, the flight control laws are being modified for said system, or a structural coupling test (SCT) is required.

b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in section 5 of MIL-STD-1530, Aircraft Structural Integrity Program (ASIP)  (copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil).

c. This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81387, Airframe Rigidity Test Report (copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Structural Coupling Test Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Structural Coupling Test Report shall describe the contractor's analyses and test activities associated with characterizing the flight control systems open and closed loop response to the elastic modes of the air vehicle structure.  The report shall contain the results and findings from the analyses and tests used to validate and update the aeroservoelastic analyses.

children.title: The Structural Coupling Test Report shall be based on the interpretation and evaluation of tests and analyses
Descriptions and photographs of the suspension system, test instrumentation, special test equipment, and air vehicle configurations
children.content: including fuel states, landing gear configurations, and store loadings.  Differences in the mass and structural configuration of the flight test vehicle and the SCT air vehicle shall be noted.

children.title: Descriptions of the methods used for selecting test instrumentation types, test instrumentation capabilities, and test measurement locations
Description of the methods used for orienting sensors to airframe's coordinate system
Description of the methods used for mounting instrumentation
Descriptions of the test procedures, test conditions, test methods, data acquisition system, and methods of data reduction analysis
Copy of the final version of the test plan
Description of the version of the flight control laws used
Description of the automatic flight control system architecture for all axes
children.content: including the location of sensors, as well as diagrams and schematics of software filters, test signal injection points, and loop breaks.

children.title: Description of the methods used for selecting test cases, including nominal and failure states
Copy of the test matrix as planned to be executed
Definition of the measurement units including axis labels for plots and figures
Plots comparing measured control law frequency response in all axes
Plots of the structural transfer functions versus frequency for accelerations and rates
Copy of the test log as executed
Comparison of the measured gain and phase margin results for testing with the pre-test analysis
children.content: including the resolution of all test discrepancies and anomalies.
